Privacy policy

About this website

This website introduces Timothy Madu and the Business Playbook Series. This initial policy describes the features included in this version. The publisher must review and update it before a public launch or any change to data collection.

Browsing and search

Catalogue search runs in your browser. This site does not include advertising trackers, analytics scripts or a mailing list. The hosting provider may process technical request information, including IP addresses, for operation and security. If the site is private, ChatGPT sign-in and access are managed by the hosting provider.

Contact enquiries

The contact form is disabled until delivery and spam protection are configured. When enabled, it collects your name, email address and message to respond to your enquiry. Cloudflare Turnstile processes a security challenge and Resend delivers the message to the publisher. Do not submit payment details or sensitive personal information.

Storage and retention

Messages are not stored in the website catalogue or content files. Delivered messages are retained in the publisher’s configured inbox and may appear in the mail provider’s delivery logs. The publisher must set and disclose a retention period, a privacy contact and any other required disclosures before enabling the form.

Third-party links

Purchase buttons, when configured, take you to an external seller. That service handles its own payments, delivery and privacy practices. No payment details are collected by this website.

Your enquiries

A public privacy contact has not yet been supplied. Privacy enquiries and applicable rights requests should use the publisher’s contact details once added. This policy needs final publisher review before public launch.
